rationale: G1 golden stores event_op_0, event_op_1, event_op_2, and delayed event_op_2_reg as five-bit registers, but reduction logic reads only operation bits [2:0]. Bits [4:3] are golden-only cone-dead operation encoding storage; the readable shared RTL stores only [2:0], preserving every consumed operation bit and therefore correctly has no impl counterparts. Strict FM observed exactly these eight ref unread points with impl unread=0, failing=0, unmatched=0, and native SUCCEEDED.
